evals.name: extract-from-vercel
evals.prompt: Extract design tokens from https://vercel.com. Write a Python Playwright script to visit the site and extract colors, typography, spacing, border radius, and shadows. Save the output as design-tokens.json.
evals.expected_output: A design-tokens.json file with extracted color values (hex/rgb), font families, font sizes, spacing values, border radius values, and shadow values from vercel.com. Colors should include primary, secondary, accent, background, foreground, muted, border, destructive.

assertions.name: output-file-created
assertions.check: File design-tokens.json exists in the output directory

assertions.name: has-colors
assertions.check: design-tokens.json contains a 'colors' object with at least 5 color properties

assertions.name: has-typography
assertions.check: design-tokens.json contains a 'typography' object with fontFamily

evals.name: default-tokens-no-url
evals.prompt: Generate default design tokens for a modern website. No reference URL provided. Save as design-tokens.json.
evals.expected_output: A design-tokens.json file with sensible default modern color palette (blues/grays), Inter/system fonts, standard spacing scale, border radius scale, and shadow scale.

assertions.name: has-primary-color
assertions.check: design-tokens.json.colors.primary exists and is a valid hex or rgb color

evals.name: extract-dark-theme-site
evals.prompt: Extract design tokens from https://stripe.com. Focus on extracting their color palette including dark mode colors if detectable. Save as design-tokens.json.
evals.expected_output: A design-tokens.json file with Stripe's color palette (blues, purples) and typography. Should capture their distinctive brand colors.

assertions.name: has-brand-colors
assertions.check: design-tokens.json.colors.primary exists and is in blue/purple range (not default gray)
